_comment: Authenticated Juice Shop scan via the REST login (default demo admin; public knowledge). Juice Shop authenticates by bearer token kept in localStorage, so the login response token is extracted (token_json_path) and seeded into the browser session (token_storage_key). The host performs this login before any agent runs - secrets never enter prompts. Use with `vulnem scan http://juice-shop:3000 --network <net> --creds lab/juice-shop-creds.json`.
